items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: He played piano with Chick Webb. This is when we were playing the college dates. This is around '36 or '37.

ctx.x: He was picked by -- Why -- we couldn't get -- Chick -- wasn't thinking about (inaudible). Chick Webb never got rid of anybody in that band. He was like Duke. He never got rid of anybody. But then we played Yale. That's the time I told you that Steel -- You got a date there on Dr. Steel -- piano player.
